Conductance models: the factory interface

Source: R/radish_conductance_model.R
terradish_conductance_model_factory.Rd

A conductance model maps the spatial covariates at each raster cell to a positive conductance. Conductance models are created by factories, which are functions of class "terradish_conductance_model_factory". Pass a factory to the conductance_model argument of terradish.

Details

Choosing a model.

loglinear_conductance

Log-linear conductance in the formula terms, including factors, interactions, and polynomial terms. The default.

smooth_loglinear_conductance

Log-linear conductance with fixed-degree regression splines for s() terms.

gaussian_smoothed_loglinear_conductance

A constructor that returns a factory. Selected rasters are Gaussian smoothed and each smoothing scale is estimated with the coefficients.

Interface. A factory has the signature factory(formula, x), where formula is the conductance formula (its left-hand side is ignored) and x is the data frame of covariates stored in a conductance_surface object (surface$x). terradish calls the factory for you. It returns a function of class "terradish_conductance_model" that takes the conductance parameter vector theta and returns a list with conductance (one positive value per graph vertex), confint (a function giving pointwise intervals from a parameter covariance matrix), and the derivative functions df__dtheta, df__dx, d2f__dtheta_dtheta, and d2f__dtheta_dx that the optimizer uses. The returned function carries a "default" attribute with named starting values, and may carry "lower" and "upper" bounds. The legacy class names "radish_conductance_model_factory" and "radish_conductance_model" are also carried for compatibility.

All built-in models use a log link, so every coefficient is a change in log conductance and exp() of a coefficient is a conductance multiplier. No intercept is estimated, because a common conductance multiplier is absorbed by the measurement model.

Worked examples

See vignette("v01-getting-started", package = "terradish") for a log-linear model, vignette("v05-categorical-conductance", package = "terradish") for class contrasts, vignette("v06-spline-conductance", package = "terradish") for nonlinear curves and their plots, and vignette("v07-gaussian-scale-optimization", package = "terradish") for estimated smoothing scales.

See also

loglinear_conductance, smooth_loglinear_conductance, gaussian_smoothed_loglinear_conductance, terradish
